title: C191 — Intake manifold runner control bank 1 (IMRC1) solenoid
introduction:
This reference identifies the electrical connector for the intake-manifold runner-control solenoid. The intake manifold distributes incoming air to the cylinders; this sheet focuses on the solenoid’s electrical connections. I read its supply and controller assignments separately—sharing a housing does not mean the wires share a job.

Begin with CNumber and Description, compare the housing illustration, then follow each cavity label across the assignment table. The result is a map of the intended connections, not a verdict on solenoid operation. Physical access, viewing-side confirmation, probing and replacement require matching service information. The gauge convention and Size and Used codes remain unexplained reference fields.

edits.why: The printed illustration places the cavity labels vertically inside a central terminal area, with a broad latch structure to the left and a narrow rectangular feature to the right. I use those features together to distinguish the housing. The Fpn and Harness Id table associates the drawing with its listed record. These positions describe the page; the physical viewing side and release movement are unspecified.

Use the Cavity column to join each illustrated label to its circuit, wire description, function and terminal reference. One assignment identifies the fused supply; the other identifies the powertrain controller’s runner-control connection. That distinction is the useful lesson here: the solenoid’s electrical map separates its supply from its control connection. Neither label establishes voltage, switching behavior or component condition. Use the mapped identities when consulting the matching diagnostic procedure.
